composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Paint Kagura with her familiar orange hair buns and modest red high-collar top, preserving her youthful age and compact proportions. She gently holds the lower sleeve edges with both hands while looking toward the viewer with a bright closed-mouth smile. Use opaque gouache in apricot, muted red, and cream, with a few deliberate shadow planes beneath the hair and collar. Keep the bun ornaments simple and safely within the circular crop. Both eyes are fully visible, and the face is lively without oversized baby features. The background remains a quiet warm field with no umbrella or additional accessories. Inside both visible irises, place a red Mangekyo-inspired design using an original simple rotating black petal pattern, a clear pupil, and bright catchlights; the marks stay entirely inside the irises. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
